description: Cancel an upcoming booking with a reason. Updates booking status and sends cancellation notifications. When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'cancel_booking' on Bump to Baby Store (bumptobabysa.co.za). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'get_studio_info' or 'get_scan_packages_and_pricing' or 'get_gestational_guide' for their respective operations). Parameters: booking_id (required), reason (required). Behavior & Side Effects: Strictly read-only, idempotent query with zero state mutation; public unauthenticated access allowed; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

booking_id.description: The booking record ID to cancel [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

reason.description: Reason for cancellation (e.g. "Scheduling conflict", "Doctor scheduled medical scan instead") [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

name: cancel_booking
title: Cancel Booking
